images.title: Beacon at Blackwood
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: finished 16:9 desktop wallpaper for the Hyper Fusion Blackwood theme, landscape, requested 3840x2160.
Primary request: A dramatic rocky North Atlantic headland with an old whitewashed lighthouse and slate keeper cottages to the right of center. A winding footpath through purple heather and muted olive grasses leads toward the warm amber beacon. A deep sheltered sea channel to the left, distant basalt cliffs receding into mist, crashing ivory surf. Huge layered grey-green storm clouds, a narrow pale champagne break in the horizon. Wide view from a hillside with foreground rocks.
Style: exquisite cinematic natural landscape, painterly realism with convincing finely detailed stone, water, weathered timber and vegetation. Richly atmospheric, restrained and elegant, never cartoonish.
Lighting and palette: storm charcoal, weathered walnut, muted sage and olive, ivory sea foam, small aged-brass amber lights. Deep but readable shadows. Natural subdued saturation.
Composition: a complete edge-to-edge scenic wallpaper with generous calm sky and mist for desktop readability; focal landmark off center; no enormous object filling the frame.
Constraints: landscape artwork only. No words, letters, logos, watermarks, UI, frames, taskbars, windows, desktop icons, people, or poster typography. This is one of three distinct original Blackwood wallpapers.
